## Natural history notes

A medium-sized short-winged grasshopper characterized by its slender body, long hind legs, brown to greenish coloration, and narrow, reduced wings that give it the “linear-winged” appearance. In Florida, it is found in open grassy habitats such as prairies, pine flatwoods, marsh edges, roadsides, fields, and other sunny areas with low vegetation. It feeds mainly on grasses and other herbaceous plants, usually staying low in vegetation or on the ground and relying on camouflage and quick jumps rather than long flight when disturbed.
